pkgmetadata.longdescription: Scalable Vector Search (SVS) is a performance library for vector similarity search, targeting high-dimensional approximate nearest-neighbor search (ANNS) workloads on x86 CPUs. It uses multi-arch AVX2/AVX-512 dispatch and the Vamana graph-based index algorithm.

use.flag: Enable NUMA-aware data structures via sys-process/numactl
